name: Deposit Completeness Contract
governs: What a FINISHED deposit carries beyond its canonical bytes: authored wiki article (WIKI-002, ≥60 words), defines_concepts (CONCEPTS-001), related_deposits (RELATED-001), a lexical-minting receipt (LEX-001), citation-graph edges for every body AXN reference (CITE-001), an artifact-free rendered record carrying its own AXN (RENDER-001), and verified declared files (FILES-001). Attested absence is explicit: concepts_attested_none / related_attested_none / lexical_attested_none — absence must be a decision, never a default. Enforced by scripts/deposit_completeness.py as the pipeline `completeness` stage before commit; fails closed.
origin: MINT #1443/#1444 repair session, 2026-08-09: both deposits shipped with empty LLM-tier fields, no lexical receipt, and records rendered before the citation graph existed; the only element that shipped complete was the only one with a hard gate (WIKI-001).

rules.desc: lexical-minting-registry rows for this deposit or lexical_attested_none
every body AXN reference present as a citation-graph edge
record page exists, carries its AXN, zero literal-markdown artifacts
every declared file exists with matching sha256 and bytes

EVID-001.rule: A write-up carries its evidentiary basis: rounds, fetches, captures and process record travel with the deposit rather than beside it.
EVID-001.satisfied_by: a body section headed appendix, exhibits, evidence, evidentiary, verification record, capture record, or the rounds
EVID-001.not_satisfied_by: a round-log line, which names the rounds without carrying them — the failure mode that motivated the rule
